My 2017 academic year in review

Cite as: Martin Paul Eve, "My 2017 academic year in review", eve.gd: Martin Paul Eve, December 15, 2017, https://doi.org/10.59348/gvscq-wvy59.

2017 was, as with last year, a mixed bag for me. On the positive side, OLH continues to grow, I received a grant for the peer-review project on which I am working, we released Janeway the scholarly communcations platform, and I had a number of publications out. Password was published in Korean and I am about to sign a book contract for my next monograph. I was also awarded the Medal of Honour in the Humanities of Social Sciences and nominated for a leadership award.00 On the downside, I was seriously ill, suffering from pneumonia, sepsis, a spinal column infection, and sudden sensorineural hearing loss. I also learned that my adrenal cortex appears to be permanently damaged, so I will have to take steroids for the rest of my life. On the other hand, though, things could be worse. Onwards to 2018!
